description: 河川河道 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 1. 本資料集係彙整自各政府機關及受政府機關委託計畫之資料而繪製供公開參考之河川圖資。 有關中央管河川仍應以經濟部公告之中央管及跨省市河川之河川界點為主。 2. 河川（河道）資料，用以提供各政府機關及受政府機關委託計畫之民間機構、團體或學術單位使用，欄位顯示為河川中文名稱，地理空間資料表現形式為，資料筆數總計13,262筆。 3. 河流有... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
